entries.prompt: Isolate ONLY the complete rigid mask worn by the single character in this official PHG PRE-RELEASE preview photo from10December2019,exact published photo05 (individual class/cosmetic name UNMAPPED). Preserve actual source camera,yaw/pitch/roll,projected asymmetry,proportions,whole visible outline,coarse panels/relief,apertures and apparent palette/local lighting. Do not turn it into a named Hunter/Scout/Berserker or substitute another film/game mask. It is a source-numbered2019preview study,not proof of a final-retail design. SUBJECT FEATURES: Preserve the smooth elongated dark gunmetal crown with its source sweeping curved segmented forehead panel lines,lower narrow brow and dark patterned optical/eye insert,the angular tapered central lower face and the existing swept lateral cheek blades/curves. Keep source head pitched down and turned toward image-right,with asymmetrical projected cheek widths. The raised biological hand and separate smart-disk held to image-right are NOT mask pieces,exclude them entirely. Do not invent a new bright red temple-lens module absent from this source view. Exclude ALL wearer biological skin/eyes/mandibles,dreadlocks/hair rings,neck,body,armor,weapons,held items and background. Keep only source-visible rigid mask and truly attached fittings. Where source contains physically opaque dark optics/mesh insert,keep it opaque dark; where a true empty aperture is shown,keep it an open transparent hole without living eyes/skin behind it. Do not invent hidden side/back/interior or unknown architecture behind openings. No new vents,holes,runes,glyphs,ornaments,unseen lenses or speculative microdetail. Fine relief is limited by roughly100–200source pixels at mask: retain coarse source shapes,do not claim exact mesh or UV. Exactly ONE complete isolated hard mask,genuine transparent RGBA,centered with10percent clear transparent margin all around,longest axis78-80percent canvas,crown/upper rim/chin entirely visible. No background/floor/shadow plane,halo/glow,UI,text,alternate views or other masks. A follows source visible material/lighting/palette; no new art direction or colorway.
